title: High-Level Design

node_notes.console: This is the UART output sink for boot/status logs and application telemetry. The platform I/O logger, queued CSV transmitter, and FirmGen telemetry all use USART2.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries diagnostic logs and telemetry using PA2 for TX and PA3 for RX. platform_io.c initializes it at the configured baud rate and writes through HAL or LL USART operations.
node_notes.sensors: The sensor service schedules MPU6050 sampling and DHT22 reads, calibrates acceleration, and publishes a snapshot. Its timing and validation behavior are implemented in firmware/services/sensors.c.
node_notes.telemetry: The CSV telemetry service formats VPD1 records from the current sensor snapshot and event. It schedules records using APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS and queues them through platform_io_telemetry.
node_notes.imu: The MPU6050 supplies acceleration samples used for calibration and ride-event detection. Its configured address is 0x68, and the sensor service reaches it through the platform I2C read/write callbacks.
node_notes.ride: The ride-event module compares acceleration samples against configured thresholds and determines event and LED states. app_start submits samples and calls ride_events_update on eligible display-ready iterations.
node_notes.led: PA5 is the application indicator LED output. platform_io_led uses HAL_GPIO_WritePin, with the active-high board level supplied by board_led_level.
node_notes.sh_drv: The SH1106 driver forms initialization, page-addressing, and pixel-data packets. The display service passes platform_io_transmit as its send callback for the I2C display.
node_notes.fgtelemetry: FirmGen telemetry captures boot information and periodically emits runtime data using the UART handle provided by platform_io.c. app_start starts and polls it, and its UART output uses HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.display: The display service manages initialization, splash timing, dashboard rendering, and page refreshes. It uses the SH1106 driver and the platform I/O transmit callback.
node_notes.mpu_drv: The MPU6050 driver verifies identity, configures the accelerometer, and converts register data to g values. It obtains register transfers through the I/O callbacks supplied by the sensor service.
node_notes.dht_drv: The DHT22 driver checks the five-byte frame checksum and converts the data to temperature and humidity. The sensor service calls dht22_decode after the platform layer captures a frame.
node_notes.oled: The SH1106 is the dashboard and startup-logo display at I2C address 0x3C. The display service sends its commands and pixel pages through the SH1106 driver and I2C transport.
node_notes.app: app_start coordinates initialization and the cooperative runtime loop. It invokes sensor, ride-event, display, platform I/O, and telemetry APIs in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.i2c: I2C1 connects the MPU6050 and SH1106 using PB8 for SCL and PB9 for SDA. These pin assignments and the HAL I2C initialization and transfers are defined in app_config.h and platform_io.c.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 supplies temperature and humidity readings through its single-wire data connection on PB4. The platform I/O layer drives and samples this pin to capture frames.
node_notes.platform: This STM32-specific module owns I2C1, USART2, TIM3 timing, DHT22 pin sampling, and the PA5 LED operation. Its HAL/LL implementations and configured pin muxes are in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.
